origin.description: Where `language` came from: `sessao` (fixed in this session) > `conta` (Account choice) > `detectado` (detected AND confirmed) > `interface` (the interface language).

account.description: `automatico` or the code chosen on the Account.

400.description: Body without `language`, or a code that is not a recognized BCP-47 language.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project or session does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
